name: ASX MAXIMUM EDGE V8-I Data Gateway V3.1 Tier-1 Timestamp Acceptance Test
red_conditions: source timestamp in future beyond tolerance
temporal price disagreement when sources are comparable

tier_1.purpose: prove timestamped acquisition and repeatability while preserving the iTick Free Plan budget

promotion_requirements: iTick timestamp present for every default symbol in every snapshot
at least one GREEN primary observation
execution authorization remains separate and must not be inferred
failure_policy: Provider errors, rate-limit exhaustion, missing symbols and missing timestamps are surfaced as explicit diagnostic failures; they are never silently converted into zero timestamp observations.
depth_rule: Depth freshness cannot inherit quote timestamp. The current REST depth response is UNKNOWN unless its own source timestamp is supplied.
cross_validation_rule: A timestamp-less secondary source may corroborate price but cannot prove temporal freshness.
